slides.title: Stuck on the couch with a cold? The house can run on 3 things.
Clean dishes for tomorrow
slides.body: Run the dishwasher or wash a few cups. Enough for the next day, that's all.

slides.title: Trash out of the room you're in
slides.body: One bag by the couch. Tissues and wrappers go straight in.

slides.title: One load of clothes
slides.body: Towels and pajamas only. Everything else can wait.

slides.title: Make a 'come back' list
slides.body: Write what you're skipping. When you feel better, you'll know where to start.

slides.title: Rest is not falling behind. It's how you get back up.
Want a gentle restart for after?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.
